description: Cloudflare WAF (Web Application Firewall) Rules for simplystylo.com

rules.description: Whitelist verified search engine and AI crawlers (Google, Bing, Perplexity, OpenAI, Anthropic)
rules.expression: (cf.client.bot or cf.verified_bot_category in {"Search Engine Crawler" "AI Crawler" "Search Engine Optimization"}) and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/")

rules.description: Block known malicious threat actors and suspicious automated vulnerability scanners
rules.expression: (cf.threat_score gt 40 and not cf.client.bot) or (http.request.uri.path contains ".env" or http.request.uri.path contains "wp-admin" or http.request.uri.path contains ".git")

rules.description: Rate limit /api/contact submissions to prevent automated mailer spam (challenge requests > 5/minute)
